# 63 BYLANE

> 63 BYLANE is a 100% vegetarian, Italian-inspired pizza and pasta restaurant in Kandivali East, Mumbai, open since 2016. Jain and vegan options available. Pizzas use 48-hour fermented dough and sauces are made in house.

## Key facts
- Address: Emp 56, Shop No. 63, Thakur Village, Kandivali East, Mumbai 400101, India
- Hours: every day, 11 AM to 2 AM
- Phone: +91 77100 27263 · WhatsApp: +91 77100 63463 · Email: contactus@63bylane.com
- Delivery: within about 5 km of the kitchen; order direct at https://order.63bylane.com (best offers), also on Zomato and Swiggy
- Diet: 100% vegetarian; Jain and vegan versions of many dishes
- Operated by Kloves Cuisines Private Limited
